comment: An enable gate jack replaces its band's button while a cable is present rather than being summed with it (band.cpp:225), so the button has no effect at all until the cable is pulled. With the menu following the input pitch, the TUNE knob and the V/OCT jack are both ignored (band.cpp:204). The display is a spectrum of the input drawn on a harmonic axis, with each band drawn as a coloured bell on its own harmonic.
